messages:
alex_cs: Customer (internal ticket 6421) reports answers became shorter and more 'weasel-y' after last weekend's auto-quant calibration. They say specific prompts now return unrelated product names. customer pasted sample -> asking for triage. :frowning:

lena_support: Acked, can you paste failing sample and the model id? I'll ask for SLA workaround.

alex_cs: Sample:
```
{ "model": "redwood-alpha-7b", "prompt": "List steps to reset router model X1000", "max_tokens":150 }
```
Customer output used to be step-by-step; now response is a 1-line marketing pitch mentioning other vendor. They rolled into production at 2024-11-03 02:00 UTC under rollout id r-2024-11-03-autoquant. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Rollout r-2024-11-03-autoquant applied: quant_profile=qp-981, mode=INT8, canary=10%

maria_ml: I looked at quant_profile qp-981 — it's an auto-calibrated INT8 profile with per-tensor dynamic scales. Calibration job used dataset-sample-v2 not v1 (different distribution). Likely calibration shift. Top candidate: scale underflow on attention softmax.

tim_infra: Can we repro locally with qp-981? If it's calibration-only, revert to previous profile qp-932 or switch fallbacks to FP8 for that model.

maria_ml: Repro steps I used:
```
export MODEL=redwood-alpha-7b
export PROFILE=qp-981
python serve_repro.py --model $MODEL --quant-profile $PROFILE --prompt-file failing_samples.json
```
I see KL divergence of logits vs baseline ~0.27 and top-1 token change rate 31% on that sample set.

alex_cs: Customer asked for immediate mitigation; can we enable per-customer override to use qp-932? They are on Dedicated but using hosted rollback path.

tim_infra: I'll open a fast revert: set routing rule to map their org -> qp-932 for that model. Need approval from product for config change >10 orgs, but emergency allowed.

lena_support: I'll message the customer asking for a few more examples + conversation logs and confirm rollback timeline. Also requesting call tomorrow.

maria_ml: Long-term fix: re-run calibration with representative dataset including recent docs + apply per-channel bias correction. Also adding a guarded fallback in runtime: if avg KL > 0.1 then auto-fallback to FP8/FP16 for that request.

alex_cs: Thanks. Please post the revert ticket id once done. Also adding sample ids to cs ticket: S-9854,S-9860,S-9872

deploy-bot: Hotfix ticket created: HOTFIX-4712 rollback qp-981 -> qp-932 for org 10123, scheduled 2024-11-04T03:10:00Z

tim_infra: Done. Rule applied, confirm with customer.

lena_support: Customer reports immediate improvement after revert. Marking as follow-up: run calibration with mixed dataset and add regression eval to qa pipeline. :white_check_mark:

maria_ml: I'll own the regression eval. Pushing a smaller, conservative INT8 profile with per-layer min-max checks. Will report back.

alex_cs: Great. Closing the urgent escalation for now; moving to postmortem and action items.
